method: Assembly/genome label and chromosome must match after trimming and lowercasing. Half-open overlap [start,end): max(starts)<min(ends); overlap bp=min(ends)-max(starts). Exact interval has equal starts and ends. No coordinate lift-over or chromosome alias normalization. Nonpositive-width intervals skipped.
coordinate_convention_source: Preprocessing BigWig querying uses [target_start,target_end), consistent with half-open use there; original source CSV coordinate convention was not independently documented.
limitations: Genome labels are mixed and not independently verified against reference assets.
Chromosome aliases are compared literally after case normalization.
Coordinates or assembly labels are missing for some samples.
